items.title: There's blood in Blue water after NSW collapse in Origin II
items.description: New South Wales travelled to the MCG with the Origin series within their grasp but after the disaster that ensued success has never felt further away.

items.title: Electricity like milk? The plan to simplify complex power bills
items.description: Millions of Australians have been often unwittingly moved to complex and variable power tariffs. An energy watchdog says bills must be simplified.

items.title: RBA warns financial industry to prepare for 'more shock-prone future'
items.description: A new era of strategic uncertainty has serious implications for Australia's financial industry, the Reserve Bank warns.

items.title: Hanson wasn't there for Press Club. She was there for Fight Club
items.description: The spectacle of the One Nation leader having a blue with journalists — or indeed anyone even vaguely associated with Canberra incumbency — is catnip for the Hanson algorithm. And the lady is not stupid.

items.title: Messi, Mbappé and Haaland shine as stars come out to play
items.description: Lionel Messi scored a hat-trick, while Kylian Mbappé and Erling Haaland both scored braces on a night where the World Cup's biggest stars shone brightest.

items.title: Quick hits: Mbappé's stunning goal and why this coach refused to pose
items.description: Kylian Mbappé's magical strike thrust him back into the World Cup spotlight, while master coach Marcelo Bielsa did everything he could to avoid it. French journalists leave an empty space and Jesus gets a Mexican kit makeover. Here's the five quick hits from the FIFA World Cup.

items.title: Millions displaced, hundreds of thousands killed: Why Sudan is 'hell' on Earth
items.description: Sudanese Australians are kept up at night thinking of family and friends trapped as a result of one of the world's worst humanitarian crises.

items.title: 'Moment of grief': Pakistani police apologise for 9yo Australian girl's death
items.description: Pakistani officials apologise for the fatal shooting of a nine-year-old Australian girl, and outline the violation of protocols that led to her death as they pursue murder charges against the officer involved.

items.title: El Niño has arrived and it could be the most volatile yet
items.description: El Niño is declared and scientists say the climate change is making its impacts harder to predict.

items.title: Perry stars in big win over Bangladesh
items.description: Ellyse Perry has starred with bat and ball as Australia gave their net run-rate a massive boost with a landslide win over Bangladesh at Headingley in the T20 World Cup.

items.title: Cooper Connolly continues impressive form with bat in T20 win
items.description: Cooper Connolly and the Aussie spinners have guided Australia to a T20 win over Bangladesh with 10 balls to spare.

items.title: Trump comes face to face with the targets of his ire at G7
items.description: In France, the US president finds himself among a group of emboldened counterparts, many of whom now seem more comfortable criticising him publicly than ever before.

items.title: Jeremy Clarkson reveals 'aggressive' cancer diagnosis
items.description: The former Top Gear host shared the news on an episode of his Clarkson's Farm reality series, shortly before undergoing surgery that removed "10 per cent" of his prostate.

items.title: Legal aid worker caught in bed with fugitive teen killer pleads guilty
items.description: A 37-year-old legal aid worker who was arrested while sharing a hotel bed with a teenage killer she helped evade authorities after he breached his parole has pleaded guilty to attempting to pervert the course of justice.

items.title: What happened when Ann Patchett quit swearing for good
items.description: The bestselling author of books including Bel Canto, Tom Lake and her latest, Whistler, is determined to see the good in everyone.

items.title: Six gaming experts share their favourite video games of the year so far
items.description: From cosy builders to hectic shooters and all the way through to nostalgic adventures, there are lots of gems to enjoy on your favourite game console so far this year.

items.title: Bluey speaks Indigenous language in time for NAIDOC week
items.description: The animated award-winning cartoon series Bluey has been translated into Yolŋu Matha, from north-east Arnhem Land, for NAIDOC Week.

items.title: Father of 17yo killed in e-bike crash speaks after teen driver sentenced
items.description: A Gold Coast father whose son died in an electric bike crash has spoken out after the driver was sentenced, saying the devices need better regulation.

items.title: Censure motion against Tasmanian premier passes parliament
items.description: A censure motion against Jeremy Rockliff has passed, making him the first premier to be censured by the Tasmanian parliament.

items.title: Japan raids ice cream companies over alleged price fixing cartel
items.description: Six of Japan's biggest ice cream companies are under suspicion of forming a cartel to hike up prices.

items.title: 13-year-old's death prompted promises of reform. Her mother says little has changed
items.description: The mother of Kate Savage, whose death at 13 sparked a review of mental health supports for children, says she's lost faith promises of reform will ever be kept.

items.title: After 11 years on a housing wait list, Lynette is getting desperate
items.description: As the number of people waiting for social housing continues to grow, the amount of available homes is falling as a proportion of Australia's total housing stock.

items.title: Cambodia says 310,000 suspected scammers left country amid crackdown
items.description: A report by Amnesty International casts doubt on the impact of Cambodia's high-profile scam industry crackdown, finding authorities failed to dismantle the "vast majority" of operations.

items.title: Kyle Sandilands responds to his $12m settlement with ARN Media
items.description: In an ASX announcement on Wednesday, ARN Media agreed to pay the shock jock $12.09 million, with $3 million payable as soon as next month.

items.title: Brisbane's Lang Park to undergo largest upgrade in 23 years
items.description: The LNP government has announced plans for the largest upgrade to Lang Park in 23 years, featuring greater capacity, wraparound screens, and new entertainment zones ahead of next week's budget.
